method: Independent public webcam clips, chronological nonoverlapping hour windows; unchanged automatic detector and normal 10 km context search; no camera coordinate passed as a search candidate.

cameras.reference_note: Published lighthouse landmark position; not a surveyed microphone position. Camera operator places the camera at the lighthouse.
cameras.selection_note: An independent reimplementation reported audible aircraft in this archive; it was selected as a likely positive-signal case, not as a random sample.

cameras.reference_note: Public operator identifies Greenville / Moosehead Lake; the exact position of this event's PTZ camera is unconfirmed, so no metre-accuracy claim will be made.
cameras.clock_basis: First source video frame displays 2026-09-12 09:54:52 America/New_York (UTC-04:00); six seconds earlier than platform release_timestamp.
